name: yahoo_dsp-mcp
description: Yahoo DSP (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, pause_resume. Every tool maps to a documented en

platform_mcp_yahoo_dsp_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_YAHOO_DSP_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_yahoo_dsp_client_id.description: DSP API client ID (DSP UI → your name → My Account → Activate; shown once). The JWT issuer is built as idb2b.dsp.dspapi.<client_id>, so enter the ID without that prefix.

platform_mcp_yahoo_dsp_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_YAHOO_DSP_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_yahoo_dsp_client_secret.description: DSP API client secret shown with the client ID; it signs the HS256 client assertion.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /traffic/seats: the seats the API user can access; verifies the JWT client assertion and the X-Auth-Token.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: GET /traffic/advertisers?page&limit (max 100): advertisers on the seat; the id is the accountId used for campaigns.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: GET /traffic/campaigns?accountId&page&limit (max 100). budget/daily_budget come from the first budget schedule (all schedules are in raw.budgetSchedules). `status` is not applied.
